18. (Currently amended) An aircraft comprising:
a fuselage;
a wing extending from the fuselage, wherein the wing comprises a front spar and one or more ribs;
one or more struts, wherein a rear surface of the one or more struts are linearly aligned with a front surface of the front spar;
an engine secured to the one or more struts distally from the wing; and
a coupling system securing the one or more struts to the wing, the coupling system comprising:one or more splice straps that secure the one or more struts to the wing, wherein the one or more splice straps are integrally formed with the one or more struts and the wing, wherein the one or more splice straps secure to both the one or more struts and the one or more ribs, and wherein the one or more splice straps are vertically and longitudinally aligned with the one or more struts and the one or more ribs,
wherein the one or more splice straps comprise:one or more upper splice straps extending over a first top surface of a rear end of the one or more struts and a second top surface of a front end of the one or more ribs, wherein the one or more upper splice straps comprise a first upper splice strap, a second upper splice strap, and a third upper splice strap between the first upper splice strap and the second upper splice strap; and
one or more lower splice straps extending over a first bottom surface of the rear end of the one or more struts and a second bottom surface of the front end of the one or more ribs, wherein the one or more lower splice straps comprise a first lower splice strap,
Page 3 a second lower splice strap, and a third lower splice strap between the first lower splice strap and the second lower splice strap; andan upper mounting plate spanning over the one or more struts and the wing, wherein the upper mounting plate provides provide a base on which the first upper splice strap, the second upper splice strap, and the third upper splice strap securely mount to the one or more struts and the wing, wherein the first upper splice strap is secured directly over a first rib, and wherein the second upper splice strap is securely directly over a second rib; and
a lower mounting plate spanning below the one or more struts and the wing, wherein the lower mounting plate provides a base on which the first lower splice strap, the second lower splice strap, and the third lower splice strap securely mount to the one or more struts and the wing, wherein the first lower splice strap is secured directly under the first rib, and wherein the second lower splice strap is secured directly under the second rib.

an upper mounting plate configured to span over the one or more struts and the wing, wherein the upper mounting plate is configured to provide a base on which the first upper splice strap, the second upper splice strap, and the third upper splice strap securely mount to the one or more struts and the wing, wherein the first upper splice strap is configured to secure directly over a first rib, and wherein the second upper splice strap is configured to secure directly over a second rib; and
